claim_boundary: the complete historical sample has been visible to earlier CZSC research and is not independent OOS
the 2024plus segment is a locked temporal validation inside this study, not prospective confirmation
a passing result creates a forward-test candidate only
a failing result closes this exact exit overlay without state, cooldown, cost, or threshold rescue

mechanism.hypothesis: FSM deterioration states are more useful as a causal exit and risk-control overlay on the unchanged factor F path than as an entry selector
motivation_fixed_before_outcomes: the Stage-2 FC entry gate was falsified and reduced slot utilization
the factor F path remains the unchanged identity-selection baseline
states 9 Divergence and 10 Breakdown have fixed bearish semantics and were already the production FSM exit family

factor_baseline.decision_frequency: frozen ranked-surface decision dates at the session close
factor_baseline.membership_rule: retain prior target identities if present with factor_rank<=75, then fill by factor_rank and symbol to 50
factor_baseline.historical_reconstruction_gate: rebuilt F weekly slots, buys, sells, and gross proxy returns must reproduce the frozen Stage-2 F path

execution.overlay_signal_time: first held-session close observed in state 9 or 10
execution.overlay_exit_fill: next observable stock open after the signal; suspended positions remain pending
execution.overlay_cash_rule: after an overlay exit the slot stays cash until the first weekly decision strictly after the signal; no midweek replacement
execution.same_decision_signal_rule: a state exit signalled on a weekly decision close cannot be repurchased at that decision's next-open fill
execution.weekly_buy_missing_open: skip the buy and keep the slot cash until a later weekly decision
execution.terminal_liquidation: liquidate at the frozen ranked surface's final common five-session endpoint open
execution.prices: qfq open for fills and qfq close for daily marks
execution.delisting_terminal_value: not modelled; missing terminal positions and pending exits are fail-closed completeness findings

statistics.active_return_series: last-observed-Friday NAV pct_change of overlay minus baseline

decision_rules.development_gate: complete path and reconstruction gates; >=100 overlay exits; max-drawdown magnitude reduced >=10%; Sharpe improves >=0.10; annualized return no more than 2pp below F; weekly active-return noninferiority one-sided HAC p<0.05
decision_rules.validation_opening: validation statistics and path outputs must not be computed or persisted unless every development gate passes
decision_rules.validation_pass: complete path; >=100 overlay exits; max-drawdown magnitude reduced >=10%; Sharpe improves >=0.10; annualized return no more than 2pp below F; weekly active-return noninferiority one-sided HAC p<0.05; no validation calendar subperiod underperforms F by more than 5pp
decision_rules.cost_stress_pass: at 60bp roundtrip in both development and validation, annualized return is no more than 3pp below its same-cost F baseline and max-drawdown magnitude is lower
decision_rules.candidate_status: RETROSPECTIVE_RISK_OVERLAY_CANDIDATE_FORWARD_TEST_REQUIRED only if development, validation, and cost-stress gates all pass
decision_rules.failure_status: HYPOTHESIS_FALSIFIED_RETROSPECTIVE; do not rescue by testing state 9 or 10 separately, delays, cooldowns, or new thresholds
